mentions.name: cppgm-extended
mentions.description: This project teaches agents to build C++ compilers from scratch, documented in a long blog series; after iterating on many agent-built C++ compilers, it produced a version that compiles about 4x faster than GCC and Clang.
mentions.problem: Existing C++ compilers (GCC and Clang) are comparatively slow.
mentions.source_excerpt: After iterating on many agent built C++ compilers, I now have a version that compiles about 4x faster than GCC and Clang[3].

evidence.value: After iterating on many agent built C++ compilers, I now have a version that compiles about 4x faster than GCC and Clang[3].
